hi.title: Maths operators
hi.body: Python maths karta hai `+` (add), `-` (subtract), `*` (multiply) aur `/` (divide) se.

cards.title: Order of operations
cards.body: As in school maths, `*` and `/` happen before `+` and `-`. Use brackets to change the order.

hi.title: Operations ka order
hi.body: School maths ki tarah, `*` aur `/` pehle hote hain, `+` aur `-` baad mein. Order badalna ho toh brackets use karo.

cards.title: Maths with variables
cards.body: Store numbers in variables, then calculate with their names.
cards.code:
price = 4
count = 3
total = price * count
print(total)

hi.title: Variables ke saath maths
hi.body: Numbers ko variables mein store karo, phir unke naam se calculate karo.

cards.title: Spot the bug
cards.body: Give it 3 and 4 and it prints 7 instead of 12. Which line is wrong?
cards.code:
width = int(input())
height = int(input())
area = width + height
print(area)

bug.fix: Area is width times height. Line 3 should multiply with `*`, not add with `+`.

hi.title: Bug dhoondo
hi.body: 3 aur 4 do toh yeh 12 ki jagah 7 print karta hai. Kaunsi line galat hai?
hi.fix: Area width guna height hota hai. Line 3 ko `*` se multiply karna chahiye, `+` se add nahi.
